dimensions.assessment: Affects colleges and universities, and undergraduate and graduate students with disabilities seeking accommodations.

dimensions.assessment: Simplifies documentation processes for college accommodations and standardizes institutional reporting of student disability data.
dimensions.evidence: Adopt policies that make any of the following documentation submitted by an individual sufficient to establish that such individual is an individual with a disability

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $10 million in appropriations for a national center for fiscal years 2027 through 2031.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this subsection $10,000,000 for the period of fiscal years 2027 through 2031.

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new institutional eligibility policies, data collection requirements, and funding authorizations under the Higher Education Act.
dimensions.evidence: The institution will submit, for inclusion in the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS)... key data

dimensions.assessment: Creates permanent policy requirements for institutions of higher education and a 5-year funding authorization window.
